description: A React component that renders a filters bar for a mindmap interface, allowing users to filter by salary range, skill similarity, and time horizon.

methods.name: MindmapFiltersBar
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a filters bar for a mindmap, including salary range, skill similarity, and time horizon filters. It provides reset functionality and updates the filters based on user interaction.

methods.name: setSalary
methods.description: Updates the salary range filter in the parent component state.

methods.name: setSimilarity
methods.description: Updates the skill similarity filter in the parent component state.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all filters to their default values.
